basics.name: Nathan Mahnke
basics.label: Full Stack Developer
basics.summary: A recent graduate from the University of Washington with one year of experience seeking employment in the Software Development field.

work.name: Backend Engineer
work.position: Client Material AI Integration and Redesign Consultant
highlights: Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using Java/Spring Boot, improving data access efficiency by 30%.
Developed and maintained scalable microservices architecture using Docker and Kubernetes.
Optimized SQL and NoSQL database queries, reducing response times by up to 40%.
Wrote comprehensive unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito, achieving 90% test coverage.

work.name: RMS Corporation
highlights: RMS Corporation provides cutting-edge technology solutions and services, focusing on inventory management software for hundreds of warehouses across America.
Designed and implemented automation solutions reducing manual workload by using AI predictions.
Developed a decision support tool in Excel using VBA to enhance inventory management.
Simplified device evaluation processes to enhance onboarding and reduce training time.
Mentored team members on proprietary processes and tools for enhanced team proficiency.

work.name: M2 Advisory And B/D Consultants
work.position: Client Material AI Integration and Redesign Consultant
highlights: M2 Advisory And B/D Consulting is a financial services firm specializing in wealth management and client advisory services.
Redesigned annual meeting materials to align with corporate style and integrated AI voice for enhanced engagement.
Designed fillable PDF forms to replace annual emails, eliminating manual data entry.
Future-proofed PDFs for potential database integration.

projects.name: MailGuard
highlights: Produced code to handle data sanitization and indexing, model creation and training, as well as model                             testing and improvements, all of which can be found here: https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1UrVu5VIYgHIzJpsrfWlVL3z2nK-nLt93?usp=sharing
Wrote and designed a Google Site as a formal paper discussing the technical aspects of the model and its evolution.
Performed a ten minute oral presentation on the major aspects of MailGuard, such as its viability in the current market

projects.name: Database GUI
projects.description: GUI written in C# to interact with SQL Server
highlights: Developed a program to open a connection with a SQL Server instance containing a Server with tables regarding a baseball league

Further evolved this program to act as GUI which shows the content of tables and allows for the deletion and insertion of new entries (note that the deletion used cascading deletion which, if made into a product for the market, would need to be changed immediately)
All code for this project can be found here: https://github.com/nathanmahnke/DatabaseGUIMahnke

projects.name: Lavaboy and Icegirl
projects.description: Fireboy and Watergirl remake using JavaScript
highlights: Designed and implemented game mechanics and levels from the classic flash game Fireboy and Watergirl using JavaScript
Worked as part of a team with a fellow classmate, Phillip, to decompile the original game and reuse assets
Hosted this remake using Github Pages: https://philtki.github.io/Lavaboy-and-Icegirl/

projects.name: Dungeon Adventure
projects.description: Completely original dungeon adventure game made using Java
highlights: Designed algorithms for room generation using 2D arrays
Developed GUI systems to interpret 2D arrays and display corresponding game assets
Developed mechanics to allow players to interact with the world
Worked in collaboration with another student, Colton, who created the combat system
Github can be found: https://github.com/Nathan9819/TCSS360_Dungeon_Adventure_Group_Project
